description: Defines classes and functions for managing budgets, budget lines, and budget posts in an OpenERP/Odoo module, including budget state transitions and calculations of planned, practical, and theoretical amounts.

classes.name: account_budget_post
classes.description: Represents a budgetary position with methods to spread budget amounts across periods.

classes.name: account_budget_post_dotation
classes.description: Represents budget dotations with a method to compute total planned amount.

classes.name: crossovered_budget
classes.description: Represents a budget with states and transition methods.

classes.name: crossovered_budget_lines
classes.description: Represents individual budget lines with calculations for practical, theoretical, and percentage amounts.

classes.name: account_analytic_account
classes.description: Extends analytic accounts to include budget lines.

methods.name: spread
methods.description: Distributes a total amount across budget periods for a given budget post.

methods.name: _tot_planned
methods.description: Calculates total planned amount for a budget line over a period.

methods.name: budget_validate
methods.description: Transitions the budget to 'validate' state and records the validator.

methods.name: budget_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the budget, setting its state to 'cancel'.

methods.name: _prac_amt
methods.description: Calculates practical amount from analytic lines within a date range.

methods.name: _prac
methods.description: Returns practical amount for a budget line.

methods.name: _theo_amt
methods.description: Calculates the theoretical amount based on planned amount and elapsed time.

methods.name: _theo
methods.description: Returns the theoretical amount for a budget line.

methods.name: _perc
methods.description: Calculates the percentage of practical to theoretical amount.
